frameAnalysisModal.title: Frame Quality
frameAnalysisModal.measureAgainTitle: Discard the saved measurements for this night and read every frame again
frameAnalysisModal.loadFailed: The frames could not be analyzed
frameAnalysisModal.noFrames: No raw FITS sub-frames for this night. Sync them from the telescope first.
frameAnalysisModal.typicalFrame: A typical frame this night: {{stars}} stars, stars {{fwhm}} px wide, {{elongation}} times longer than wide. Each frame is judged against that.

reasons.noStars: Only {{stars}} stars found, against about {{typical}} in a typical frame this night. The sky was covered or the lens was fogged.
reasons.clouds: {{stars}} stars against about {{typical}} in a typical frame ({{percent}}% fewer).
reasons.cloudsBrighter: The sky is also brighter, which is what cloud lit from below does.
reasons.trailsPlain: Stars are {{ratio}} times longer than wide. The telescope moved or was shaken during the exposure.
reasons.trailsPlainAngle: Stars are {{ratio}} times longer than wide, stretched toward {{angle}}°. The telescope moved or was shaken during the exposure.
reasons.trailsSlight: Stars are {{ratio}} times longer than wide. A slight smear that will hardly show once the frames are stacked.
reasons.trailsSlightAngle: Stars are {{ratio}} times longer than wide, stretched toward {{angle}}°. A slight smear that will hardly show once the frames are stacked.
reasons.soft: Stars are {{fwhm}} px wide against {{typical}} px typical: out of focus, or the air was unsteady.
reasons.streak: A straight streak crosses the frame at about {{angle}}° (a satellite or aeroplane). Stacking with rejection usually removes it.
reasons.noisy: Background noise is {{percent}}% above the night's typical frame.

frameList.allClear: No clouds, trails or streaks found
frameList.timelineLabel: One mark per frame along the night, coloured by grade

sortHint.score: Sort by score (0 to 100), worst first. Compares each frame with the rest of the night.
sortHint.flags: Sort by how much is wrong with the frame: clouds, streaks, trailing
sortHint.fwhm: Sort by star width (FWHM, full width at half maximum) in pixels, sharpest first. Lower is sharper focus and steadier air.
sortHint.round: Sort by star elongation. 1.00 is perfectly round, higher means stretched stars from tracking or wind.
sortHint.noise: Sort by background noise, quietest first. Lower is cleaner.
sortHint.snr: Sort by signal: how far the brightest stars rise above the noise (×). Higher is better.
sortHint.sky: Sort by sky brightness (raw counts). A jump between frames can mean clouds, haze or the Moon.

stackingExport.title: Export for stacking
stackingExport.intro: The lights you keep, with the darks, flats, flat darks and bias from the calibration library that match them, in one ZIP ready for your stacking software.
stackingExport.wbppHint: One folder tree; WBPP sorts the frames from their headers. Several nights go in NIGHT_<date> folders: add NIGHT as a grouping keyword so each night gets its own flats.
stackingExport.sirilHint: One folder per night and filter with lights, darks, flats and biases, as Siril’s preprocessing scripts expect. Darks are repeated in each folder.
stackingExport.planFailed: Could not match the calibration frames.
stackingExport.fixHint: Add or attach the missing frames, then reopen this dialog. You can still export: stackers skip what is missing.
stackingExport.biasNotNeeded: Not needed: flat darks calibrate the flats
